arguments.body: The Chromebook carts in rooms 12 and 14 will be re-imaged on Thursday, October 22, from 3:30 to 5:00 PM. Please make sure both carts are plugged in and closed by 3:15 PM. Thank you, IT Helpdesk

arguments.subject: District SSO sign-in failures at Ridgeline Middle School (QP-SSO-221)
arguments.body: Hello QuillPath support, since 7:40 AM today, students at Ridgeline Middle School are getting 'SAML response rejected (code QP-SSO-221)' when they sign in with Larkspur Valley district SSO. About 30 students are affected. No individual accounts need changes; this appears to be an SSO-level issue. Please investigate and let us know. Thank you, Larkspur Valley IT Helpdesk
